subject: Re: Kickoff: black-box debiasing service — rollout decision
body:
Team,

Closing decisions ahead of the May 11 window end:

1) The service goes to general availability for binary classifiers now; Team A's 11.2% -> 2.1% parity-gap result headlines the rollout note.
2) Csilla's certification floor is adopted: groups below the empirical sample-size threshold get "insufficient data," never a certified badge. Kofi is comfortable with that language from a review standpoint — a false certification is the worst outcome for everyone.
3) Multiclass stays in pilot through Q3 until we've seen one more team with healthier group sizes.
4) Quentin's Corpus write-back plan is approved as scoped in March; no changes to the July port timing.

Thanks all — this is the rare fairness project that ends with a number we can defend.

Dmitri
